# Love Birds

> Love Birds is an iPhone app for couples. Each partner picks a pixel-art bird, writes or draws a short love note, seals it with wax and lets it fly. About a minute later the bird lands on the partner's windowsill: in the app, on their Home Screen widget and on their Lock Screen.

- One Love Birds+ subscription covers both partners: a 7-day free trial, then yearly.
- Built for couples who want to stay close through busy days and long distance.
- Made by Gus Tiffer. Contact: gustifferbuilds@gmail.com

## Pages

- [Home](https://getlovebirds.app/): what Love Birds is
- [Help](https://getlovebirds.app/support/): pairing, the subscription, new phones, missing birds
- [Privacy](https://getlovebirds.app/privacy/): how letters and data are handled
- [Blog](https://getlovebirds.app/blog/): ideas for writing to your partner and staying connected
